question: Does a semantic T1 Dynamic Need profile plus the T0→T1 need transition improve ranking beyond the initial Search Need alone?
hypothesis: Requested area/budget, urgency, visit request and channel observed at inquiry time refine demand enough to improve AP/lift without relying on weekday.
primary_change: add dynamic_need_profile and need_transition at T1
secondary_changes: retain original need_profile so the transition remains interpretable

target.censoring: Public candidate data has no true sale timestamp. scheduled_visit is the observed proxy; offline results are associative.

population.eligibility: Same population and temporal partitions as E006_physical_location_spot: profile calibration before 2025-09-29T12:58:37, predictive training until 2026-04-28T07:41:43, final 20% future test.
exclusions: Profile-calibration inquiries are excluded from predictive fitting.

validation.strategy: outcome-free profile selection on frozen calibration data + same temporal predictive train and untouched future test; paired cluster-bootstrap by lead_id
validation.split_description: Clusterers use only information available before the frozen profile cutoff. Predictive models use the identical train/test rows across arms. Bootstrap resamples lead_id clusters.

items.source: inquiries.requested_area/budgets, urgency_days, asked_visit, channel, message_length plus deltas to T0 lead need
items.evidence: Uses only fields present at T1. inquiry_weekday and broker_response fields are explicitly excluded.

items.information_available_at: same as its T0 and T1 components
items.evidence: No additional data source; deterministic transition label.
